command: backtest difftest -table TABLE -rules 10000 (rule-seed 1: 5,000 ungrounded; seed 2: 5,000 with constants drawn from the table)

rule_set_level.method: backtest.CheckRuleSet: EvaluateRuleSet (vectorized, chunk-local Radar-order decision) against RuleSet.Evaluate on every row: action and deciding rule

notes: The first table has risk_score NaN on every row (as exported). The second is the same replay with risk_score from models/ieee (cmd/riskgate table -model models/ieee), so rules on risk_score split the data.
A trivial rule matches no row or every row; it still checks missing-value handling but not much else. Non-trivial rules are the informative count.

Run with the evaluator as modified in this session (branch-free numeric in-lists, chunk-local decisions). An earlier 6,000-rule run on the export table with the evaluator before those changes also found 0 disagreements (3,310 non-trivial rules, 3,543,240,000 checks).
